Body


#### JazzCares supports patients and practices with


- Benefit investigation—helps patients understand their insurance coverage for RYLAZE
- Prior authorization support
- Appeals support
- Billing and coding information
- Referrals to other financial assistance


#### Travel and Lodging Assistance Programa


Patients who meet specific program criteria may be eligible for travel and lodging assistance when receiving RYLAZE


#### Savings Card


Eligible, commercially insured patients can pay as little as $0 for their RYLAZE medication, to help reduce their out-of-pocket costs subject to an annual maximum


#### Patient Assistance Programa


Uninsured or underinsured patients who meet specific financial criteria may be eligible to receive RYLAZE at no cost


aEligibility and financial criteria apply.
